name: Sun Cleric (Seraphim) threat-related abilities generate the threat their tooltips promise
contract: Justicar's Wrath 806980 (Seraphim talent, rank 1): 'Bring holy wrath down upon an enemy, dealing ... High Threat Holy damage ...' DBC Effect[1] carries SPELL_EFFECT_THREAT (effect 63, value 99 = 99%). rev_20261026_20_coa_tank_ability_threat.sql deletes the flat spell_threat row and replaces it with pctMod 2 for 806980 and its higher ranks (807789, 807790, 807791, which carry the same damage via Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE and a SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL debuff rather than their own effect 63 -- the pctMod still applies against the whole cast's threat). threat_per_damage on a struck dummy should be close to 2.0 without a tank stance.

Injunction 800624 (ClassSpells level 16): 'Taunts an enemy for $d.' DBC Effects are SPELL_EFFECT_ATTACK_ME + SPELL_AURA_MOD_TAUNT; AscensionSunClericContracts.cpp clears SPELL_ATTR1_NO_THREAT so the taunt itself still generates native combat threat. Already covered by dedicated scenarios (sun-cleric-injunction-*); re-asserted here for the class-wide batched audit.

steps.label: Justicar's Wrath: threat on the struck target is at least 2x its damage (spell_threat pctMod 2; the native flat effect 63 threat still adds on top)
